fixes.idle: The six-frame idle loop now lasts 4480 ms; the selected fourth frame holds for 1400 ms while all other frame timings stay unchanged.
fixes.hover: Uses Codex jumping x3 once per pointer entry, then holds idle; three outside samples beyond an 8 DIP margin are required before rearming.
fixes.drag: Horizontal drag deltas select running-left or running-right after a 2 DIP direction debounce; release restores the configured shape.
fixes.automaticDwell: Random shapes play two loops and automatic events use a 45-75 second quiet interval.
fixes.autoRun: When enabled, schedules a first run within 6 seconds and later runs use the same 45-75 second quiet interval.
fixes.settingsMigration: Schema 1/2 settings are upgraded once to schema 3 with auto-run enabled; later user choices persist.
tray: 自动跑动（已开启/已关闭）
